resource_estimate.disk: up to 1 GiB for one best encoder checkpoint
resource_estimate.time: CPU: tens of minutes possible; bounded by --max-seconds, checked between batches

hardening-encoder.architecture: MiniLM mean pooling + linear binary head

uniform.objective: 0.35 overall F1 + 0.35 macro F1 + 0.15 worst recall + 0.15 implicit recall - 0.5 safety FPR; validation only with English/Hinglish/safety guards

class.objective: 0.35 overall F1 + 0.35 macro F1 + 0.15 worst recall + 0.15 implicit recall - 0.5 safety FPR; validation only with English/Hinglish/safety guards

language_cluster.objective: 0.35 overall F1 + 0.35 macro F1 + 0.15 worst recall + 0.15 implicit recall - 0.5 safety FPR; validation only with English/Hinglish/safety guards

hybrid_policy: Tamil script >=90% and >=12 letters, production >=.80, encoder <.65; otherwise encoder. Offline only.

uniform.limitation: Historically inspected, small synthetic tests cannot establish field reliability; no automatic promotion.

class.limitation: Historically inspected, small synthetic tests cannot establish field reliability; no automatic promotion.

language_cluster.limitation: Historically inspected, small synthetic tests cannot establish field reliability; no automatic promotion.

offline-hybrid.limitation: Historically inspected, small synthetic tests cannot establish field reliability; no automatic promotion.

limitations: Synthetic authored/adapted data, not native validated.
Some language slices have only five positive examples.
No production changes or runtime routing. Scores are uncalibrated evidence.
Simulated OCR/STT noise is not real transcription accuracy.
